ModMetaData.name: RimAI.Communication
ModMetaData.author: juicy
ModMetaData.description:
RimAI.Communication generates dynamic, context-aware colonist dialogue. Gameplay text AI is configured in RimAI shared settings.
Key Features: • AI-powered conversations that reflect each pawn's current mood, thoughts, and situation • Context-aware dialogue based on what colonists are doing and thinking • Multi-language support for diverse colony experiences • Configurable conversation frequency and message suppression options • Shared RimAI gameplay text-AI settings (credential domain OPENAI_RIMAI)
Every conversation is unique and emergent, creating immersive storytelling experiences that evolve with your colony.
Setup: configure the shared RimAI text-AI provider in RimAI settings. Do not use translation or TTS credentials for gameplay dialogue.
